title: INHERIT v3 Dialect
description: Custom metaschema for INHERIT v3. Extends JSON Schema 2020-12 with the INHERIT estate vocabulary. Format keywords (uuid, email, date-time, uri) are intended to be validated
$comment: The estate vocabulary provides schema-level metadata keywords: jurisdiction, successionRegime, maturity, extensionType, applicableJurisdictions, inheritVersion, legalSystems, dataProvenance, maintainers, compatibleWith.
